text: (2) I, Shri,/Smti………………………………………………………..having been appointed Chairperson/Member of the Lokayukta do swear in the name of God/Solemnly affirm that I will bear true faith and allegiance to the Constitution of India as by law established and that I will duly and faithfully and to the best of my ability, knowledge and judgement perform the duties of my office without fear or favour, affection or ill-will.” Order Appendix Forms TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles Show all section The Meghalaya Lokayukta Act, 2014 (Act No. 4 of 2014)
